recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR core. If OO later changes the active SupplyDelivery or Transport guidance, reconcile that work in HL7/oo-incubator rather than in inactive core resource files.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive OO change request for R5, applied for R6, asking that SupplyDelivery and Transport be better differentiated by changing SupplyDelivery Scope and Usage to focus on dispatch and/or receipt and by adding a Boundary and Relationships paragraph explaining Transport movement between dispatch and receipt.
initial_application: Jira-tagged commit d853f5ef36 updated source/supplydelivery/supplydelivery-introduction.xml with the requested dispatch/receipt wording and Transport boundary paragraph, and the current legacy core file still contains that text.
additional_context: FHIR-45506 is related SupplyDelivery dispatch/reception guidance and is already represented on the combined branch by an external-repo audit commit. Commit 3b38b80cf2 later removed SupplyDelivery, Transport, and related OO resources from active core resource metadata and changed current core pages to link to the OO Incubator IG. The active HL7/oo-incubator SupplyDelivery source contains the same FHIR-42947 wording.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo/out-of-current-core-build audit commit. No core source was changed because the local SupplyDelivery and Transport folders are inactive legacy resource source and the active external SupplyDelivery source already has the approved clarification.

related_jiras.note: Linked from FHIR-42947 as related SupplyDelivery dispatch/reception workflow guidance and already represented on the combined branch by commit 15265393c74cf62ea6a4e83ed501fe3ab16a8425.
